meaning.en: To be the first to do something, starting a new tradition.
meaning.zh: 首先开创某种风气或做法。

examples.zh: 这部电影开了国产科幻片的先河。
examples.en: This film pioneered the domestic science-fiction genre.

examples.zh: 他的研究开先河，为后来者指明了方向。
examples.en: His research broke new ground and showed later scholars the way.

usage.en: Verb-object, neutral to formal; usually 开……之先河. 先河 is the source river, from which later waters flow.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，中性偏正式，常说“开……之先河”。“先河”指河的发源，比喻事物的开端。

meaning.en: To make promises one cannot or will not keep.
meaning.zh: 说空话许愿，不兑现。

examples.zh: 竞选时他们开了很多空头支票。
examples.en: During the campaign they made many empty promises.

examples.zh: 没有把握的事别乱开空头支票。
examples.en: Don't hand out empty promises about things you can't guarantee.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; 空头支票 is a bounced cheque. Often with 别 or 只会.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，“空头支票”指无法兑现的支票。常说“别开空头支票”“只会开空头支票”。

meaning.en: To use a matter as a pretext, or to work it for all it's worth.
meaning.zh: 借某件事发挥或大做文章，在上面下功夫。

examples.zh: 有人想在这件小事上做文章。
examples.en: Someone wants to make a big deal of this small matter.

examples.zh: 要在提高质量上做文章。
examples.en: We need to focus our efforts on raising quality.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; either negative (to blow something up) or positive (to concentrate effort on). Read the context.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，可贬可褒：既可指借题发挥，也可指下功夫。看语境。

natural: show who is boss at the start

meaning.en: A show of strength at the very start intended to intimidate others.
meaning.zh: 刚一开始就向对方显示的威力。

equivalents: a show of force at the outset

examples.zh: 新来的经理想给我们个下马威。
examples.en: The new manager wants to show us who's boss at the outset.

examples.zh: 球队用大比分给对手一个下马威。
examples.en: The team intimidated its rivals with a big score at the start.

usage.en: Noun, usually 给……下马威 or 来个下马威. Originally an official who arrived and impressed or frightened his subordinates.
usage.zh: 名词，常说“给……下马威”“来个下马威”。本指官吏初到任时向属下立威。

natural: argue for the sake of arguing

meaning.en: To argue stubbornly or pointlessly just to be contrary.
meaning.zh: 无谓地争辩，为争论而争论。

equivalents: argue for the sake of it

examples.zh: 我们不是来抬杠的，是想解决问题。
examples.en: We aren't here to bicker but to solve the problem.

examples.zh: 你们别一见面就抬杠。
examples.en: Don't start bickering the moment you meet.

usage.en: Verb or verb-object, casual; 抬杠 comes from two people carrying a pole who pull against each other. Often with 爱.
usage.zh: 动词或动宾短语，口语。来自两人抬杠子，用力方向相反。常说“爱抬杠”。

meaning.en: To secretly tamper with something to get an advantage.
meaning.zh: 暗中动手脚，做不正当的安排。

examples.zh: 这台秤被人做了手脚，重量不准。
examples.en: The scales were tampered with and the weights are wrong.

examples.zh: 比赛时有人在背后做手脚。
examples.en: Someone was rigging things behind the scenes during the contest.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; 动手脚 is also used. The object, if any, is inserted (在账目上做手脚).
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，也说“动手脚”，常说“在……上做手脚”。

meaning.en: To deliberately find fault or pick a quarrel.
meaning.zh: 故意挑毛病，借机生事。

examples.zh: 他今天心情不好，处处找茬。
examples.en: He's in a bad mood today and picks on everything.

examples.zh: 你是不是故意来找茬的？
examples.en: Are you here to pick a fight on purpose?

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; 茬 as in 找碴儿 (also written 找碴). Also the name of 'spot the difference' games.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，也写作“找碴儿”。“大家来找茬”是找不同的游戏。

meaning.en: To take on the main responsibility or the leading role.
meaning.zh: 担负主要责任或承担主要工作。

examples.zh: 这个项目由你来挑大梁。
examples.en: You will take the lead in this project.

examples.zh: 球队缺了主力，年轻球员必须挑大梁。
examples.en: With the main players out, the young players must step up.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; 挑 is read tiāo (to shoulder). The main beam of a house carries the roof, hence the main support.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，“挑”读 tiāo。大梁撑起整个房顶，比喻中坚。

meaning.en: To cause trouble for someone, or to bring trouble on oneself.
meaning.zh: 给别人添麻烦，或自找麻烦。

examples.zh: 别没事找麻烦，安静待着吧。
examples.en: Don't go looking for trouble; stay quiet.

examples.zh: 他总爱给同事找麻烦。
examples.en: He loves causing trouble for his colleagues.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; either towards others or oneself (自找麻烦). 麻烦 is read má fan.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，既可对别人也可对自己（自找麻烦）。“麻烦”读 má fan。

meaning.en: To undermine someone by luring away their staff, customers or partner.
meaning.zh: 用不正当手段拆别人的台，如拉走人才、客户或对象。

examples.zh: 竞争对手专门挖我们公司的墙脚。
examples.en: Our competitors make it their business to poach our staff.

examples.zh: 他想挖朋友的墙脚，抢走他的女朋友。
examples.en: He wants to steal his friend's girlfriend from under him.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual and derogatory; digging out the foot of a wall will bring it down.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，贬义。挖掉墙基，墙就倒了。

meaning.en: To go back to old, outdated ways when progress is needed.
meaning.zh: 比喻违背进步方向，恢复旧的做法。

examples.zh: 改革不能开倒车。
examples.en: Reform must not go into reverse.

examples.zh: 教育制度不能开倒车，要向前走。
examples.en: The education system must not go backwards but keep moving forward.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual to formal; often 不能开倒车. Can also mean literally to reverse a vehicle.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语到正式，常说“不能开倒车”，也指倒车。

meaning.en: A powerful person or group that one can rely on for protection.
meaning.zh: 可以依靠的有势力的人或集团。

examples.zh: 他有个当官的亲戚做靠山。
examples.en: He has an official relative as his backer.

examples.zh: 你有这么硬的靠山，当然不怕。
examples.en: With such strong backing, of course you aren't afraid.

usage.en: Noun, casual; often with 找/有/硬. Neutral, but may suggest improper protection.
usage.zh: 名词，口语，常说“找靠山”“有靠山”“硬靠山”。中性，有时暗示不正当庇护。

meaning.en: To gain the advantage in a contest or argument.
meaning.zh: 在争斗或竞赛中处于优势。

examples.zh: 这场比赛一开始我们就占上风。
examples.en: We had the upper hand from the start of the match.

examples.zh: 辩论时她始终占上风。
examples.en: She held the upper hand throughout the debate.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual to neutral; 占 is read zhàn. The one upwind in a battle had the advantage.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语到中性，“占”读 zhàn。作战时占据上风向者有利。

meaning.en: An amulet carried for protection; figuratively, something that keeps one safe.
meaning.zh: 带在身上保平安的符，比喻保护自己的东西。

examples.zh: 奶奶给我求了一个护身符。
examples.en: Grandma got me an amulet.

examples.zh: 他把领导的批示当护身符。
examples.en: He treated the boss's written approval as his protection.

usage.en: Noun; the literal amulet or a figurative cover for one's actions.
usage.zh: 名词，既指护身的符，也比喻用来保护自己的东西。

meaning.en: Something that keeps changing people in rapid succession, like a lantern that spins.
meaning.zh: 比喻人员或事物更替频繁。

examples.zh: 公司的人事像走马灯一样换个不停。
examples.en: The company changes its staff like a revolving door.

examples.zh: 他走马灯似的换了五份工作。
examples.en: He's switched through five jobs in rapid succession.

usage.en: Noun, usually 走马灯似的 or 像走马灯一样. A traditional lantern with paper horses that chase each other as it turns.
usage.zh: 名词，常说“走马灯似的”“像走马灯一样”。传统灯笼，转动时纸马追逐旋转。

meaning.en: To set a trap for someone, secretly arranging for them to fail.
meaning.zh: 暗中设下圈套害人。

examples.zh: 你别给我挖坑，我不会上当。
examples.en: Don't set a trap for me; I won't fall for it.

examples.zh: 他在合同里挖了个坑，等着我们跳。
examples.en: He dug a pit in the contract and waited for us to fall in.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; 挖坑 (and 挖坑给人跳, 挖坑自己填 to trap oneself). Also used in internet slang for starting a project and not finishing it.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，常说“给人挖坑”“挖坑自己跳”。网络上也指开了头却不更新的“坑”。

meaning.en: To apologise for a mistake or offence.
meaning.zh: 向人认错道歉。

examples.zh: 是我不对，我给你赔不是。
examples.en: It was my fault, and I apologise to you.

examples.zh: 他亲自上门向邻居赔不是。
examples.en: He went round in person to apologise to the neighbours.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; 赔 an apology, with 不是 meaning a wrong or fault. Often 赔个不是.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，“不是”指过错，常说“赔个不是”。

meaning.en: To put on a show of feeling that one does not really have.
meaning.zh: 假装，做样子给人看。

examples.zh: 他的悲伤都是做戏，没有人信。
examples.en: His grief is all an act and nobody believes it.

examples.zh: 你们别在我面前做戏了。
examples.en: Stop putting on an act in front of me.

usage.en: Verb-object or verb, casual; the phrase is also used for acting in a literal sense, as in 做戏做全套.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，也有“做戏做全套”的说法。

meaning.en: To arrange a link between two parties; also a bypass operation in medicine.
meaning.zh: 为双方牵线联系；也指心脏搭桥手术。

examples.zh: 朋友为我们两家公司搭桥，才有了合作。
examples.en: A friend acted as a go-between for our two firms, which led to the cooperation.

examples.zh: 他做了心脏搭桥手术，恢复得很好。
examples.en: He had heart bypass surgery and is recovering well.

usage.en: Verb-object; often 牵线搭桥 (to act as a go-between). The medical 搭桥 is a bypass.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常说“牵线搭桥”。医学上指搭桥手术。

meaning.en: To be in decline, getting worse over time.
meaning.zh: 比喻事物衰落、走向衰败。

examples.zh: 这家老企业这几年一直走下坡路。
examples.en: This old firm has been going downhill for years.

examples.zh: 他的身体已经开始走下坡路了。
examples.en: His health has started to decline.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; the opposite is 走上坡路.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，与“走上坡路”相对。

meaning.en: To pretend not to know or understand something.
meaning.zh: 明明知道，却假装不懂。

examples.zh: 别跟我装糊涂，你什么都知道。
examples.en: Don't play dumb with me; you know everything.

examples.zh: 他对这件事一直装糊涂。
examples.en: He has played dumb about the matter all along.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; sometimes positive as tact (难得糊涂). 糊涂 is read hú tu.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，有时是处世的智慧，如“难得糊涂”。“糊涂”读 hú tu。

meaning.en: A person who spends money foolishly or is easily cheated.
meaning.zh: 被人白白骗钱的人，花钱不值得的人。

examples.zh: 我可不想当冤大头，多花一倍的钱。
examples.en: I won't be a sucker and pay double.

examples.zh: 他买了个假货，成了冤大头。
examples.en: He bought a fake and ended up the sucker.

usage.en: Noun, casual; 当冤大头. 冤 here implies throwing money away.
usage.zh: 名词，口语，常说“当冤大头”。“冤”指白花钱，不值得。

meaning.en: Something that looks fearsome but is weak in reality.
meaning.zh: 外表强大、实际虚弱的东西。

examples.zh: 看起来厉害，其实他不过是个纸老虎。
examples.en: He looks tough but is really a paper tiger.

examples.zh: 别怕，那个威胁只是纸老虎。
examples.en: Don't be afraid; that threat is just bluster.

usage.en: Noun, casual to formal; widely known through Mao Zedong's 1946 remark about reactionaries. English borrowed it as 'paper tiger'.
usage.zh: 名词，口语到书面。因毛泽东1946年称反动派是纸老虎而广为人知，英语也借用。

meaning.en: A successful start to a year, season or business venture.
meaning.zh: 一开始就取得好成绩，多指新年或新项目起步顺利。

equivalents: a good start to the year

examples.zh: 祝大家新年开门红！
examples.en: Wishing everyone a great start to the new year!

examples.zh: 球队首战大胜，实现了开门红。
examples.en: The team won big in the first match for a flying start.

usage.en: Noun or verb, casual; commonly 实现开门红 or 开门大吉. Red is the colour of luck in Chinese culture.
usage.zh: 名词或动词，口语，常说“实现开门红”。红色在中国文化里象征吉利。

meaning.en: A person or reason used as cover to avoid blame or responsibility.
meaning.zh: 比喻用来推卸责任、掩盖自己的借口或人。

examples.zh: 他把工作忙当作挡箭牌，拒绝参加。
examples.en: He used being busy as an excuse to decline.

examples.zh: 别拿我当挡箭牌。
examples.en: Don't use me as your shield.

usage.en: Noun, casual; 当挡箭牌, 拿…当挡箭牌. A shield against arrows is used to avoid attack.
usage.zh: 名词，口语，常说“当挡箭牌”“拿……当挡箭牌”。
